_about: Narrative's rule-of-cool barks (docs/narrative/rule-of-cool-narrative.md). Working labels; every name and line is a placeholder in the current house style and is easy to re-style: replace a line's text by id. Orb is hand-editing the voice lab batch (docs/narrative/voice-lab/), so none of this is final. Unsearched by Legal.

event_shape._about: What a bark event carries to UI (faces.json, hud-spec section 29). A line in this file declares speaker_role; the dialogue director resolves it to the numeric fighter slot when it emits the event.
event_shape.kind: line | reply | retort | callback | jewel | thought
event_shape.speaker: a numeric fighter slot (0, 1, ...), or the string crowd, or the string narrator
event_shape.speaker_role: self | opponent | crowd | narrator (data only; resolved to speaker at emit time)
event_shape.priority: 1 ambient, 2 ordinary, 3 important, 4 set piece or shout
event_shape.face_rule: UI shows a face for a numeric speaker unless kind is thought, priority is below 2, or the speaker is crowd or narrator

shouts._about: A fighter shouts the name of a signature, special or finisher, with no name card (Orb). Legal: the name is ours, and it is never stretched into drawn-out syllables across a charge. So each shout is one short burst, fired at the start of the move, and no_stretch tells Audio to render it as a single clipped hit.

RIVAL._note: The rival is calm: a low, flat shout. The display style is shout so UI sizes it the same; Audio carries the calm.

real_fighters_stubs._about: The same shape for the two real fighters who are not in the roster's data yet (identity.md). The PROTAGONIST and RIVAL blocks above are the roster pair's. Specials and finishers use the pattern '{move_name}!' with trigger special_start or finisher_start.

taunts._about: A taunt feeds a meter only (Pride +6, heat +10, Wrath +8, Hunger +5), takes 1 s, can be punished, and shows the face cut-in. No beckoning gesture (Legal). The line is said during the second.

PROTAGONIST.gesture: a boxer's shuffle: rolls his shoulders and bounces on his toes, grinning

lines.text: Is that all? I hope not.

RIVAL.gesture: adjusts a cuff of his regalia without looking at the opponent

lines.text: Is that what you call a fight?
Look at me. I have not moved.

EMPRESS.gesture: smooths her train over one arm and tilts her chin

lines.text: We have seen better. We have commissioned better.
Do carry on. It is nearly amusing.

CYBORG.gesture: wipes a plate on his sleeve and holds out a menu

lines.text: Your table is ready. Whenever you are.
Take your time. I am not going anywhere. I am also hungry.

punished.text: Please do not interrupt the waiter.

on_the_chin._about: The rival's held absorb stance (spec-wounds.md section 3). Working label for the move: Chin Up. The bravado line plays when a signature is absorbed. 'Was that supposed to hurt?' passed Legal's exact-phrase search; the two alternates still need one.

completed_absorb.text: You may stop whenever you are ready.

last_stand._about: The free last signature is ready at the brink (spec-wounds 1b). One line each, short, no final speech (Legal).

CYBORG.text: Please hold. I am not done.

labels._about: Launch-vector labels (docs/combat/launch-vectors.md). A slam is an event and a drive is the norm.
